name: UI：视频上传节点-字段绑定方式验证(商品ID/视频)
description: 验证视频上传节点的字段绑定方式：商品ID和视频字段是否支持变量引用或模板语法绑定上游出参

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '打开'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no open btn'; })()

return (() => { const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal'); for (const m of modals) { if (m.classList.contains('ant-modal-hidden')) continue; const r = m.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width < 200) continue; const cards = m.querySelectorAll('.ant-card-hoverable, .ant-card'); for (const card of cards) { const t = card.querySelector('.ant-card-meta-title'); if (t && t.textContent.trim() === '视频上传') { card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); card.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待视频上传编辑抽屉加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const fields = []; for (const item of formItems) { const label = (item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); const hasVarBtn = !!item.querySelector('button, [class*=variable], [role=button]'); const input = item.querySelector('input, textarea'); const inputVal = input?.value || ''; const hasTemplateSyntax = inputVal.includes('{{') || inputVal.includes('stage'); const inputType = input?.type || input?.tagName || 'none'; if (label.length > 0) { fields.push({ label, hasVarBtn, hasTemplateSyntax, inputType, inputValue: inputVal.substring(0, 60) }); } } return { open: true, fieldCount: fields.length, fields }; })()
steps.description: 分析每个字段的绑定方式

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const itemIdItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('商品ID') || label.includes('商品'); }); if (!itemIdItem) return { noItemId: true }; const inp = itemIdItem.querySelector('input'); return { itemIdExists: true, itemIdType: inp?.type || 'none', itemIdPlaceholder: inp?.getAttribute('placeholder') || '' }; })()
steps.description: 检查商品ID字段交互方式

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const videoItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('视频') && !label.includes('上传'); }); if (!videoItem) return { noVideo: true }; const inp = videoItem.querySelector('input'); return { videoExists: true, videoType: inp?.type || 'none', videoPlaceholder: inp?.getAttribute('placeholder') || '' }; })()
